rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something continuing without stopping.

example.english: The tap dripped endlessly all night.
example.traditional: 個水喉成晚不停咁滴水。
example.jyutping: go3 seoi2 hau4 seng4 maan5 bat1 ting4 gam3 dik6 seoi2

rows.note: Use this when the endless continuation sounds irritating, excessive, or frustrating.

example.english: They endlessly talked about the same thing, and I was exhausted listening to them.
example.traditional: 佢哋冇完冇了咁講同一件事，聽到我都攰。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 mou5 jyun4 mou5 liu5 gam3 gong2 tung4 jat1 gin6 si6 teng1 dou3 ngo5 dou1 gui6

rows.note: Use this when you want to stress that the continuation has no limit, especially in more formal or written contexts.

example.traditional: 網上嘅爭論無止境咁延續落去。
example.jyutping: mong5 soeng6 ge3 zang1 leon6 mou4 zi2 ging2 gam3 jin4 zuk6 lok6 heoi3
